blocked_by: M2220 design must freeze metric groups, labels, and claim boundary
supersedes: manual interpretation of M2218 profile/history matrices

public_gates: M2221 must use only M2209/M2218 artifacts
M2221 must write profile/history failure diagnosis artifacts
M2221 must keep ranking_admissible false and winner_selected false
M2221 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: localizes L3 zero-success and finite-window support failure modes from existing episode metrics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rerun diagnosis only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation runs environment or policy code
stop if L3 zero-success metrics are missing
fallback_plan: route to result audit if diagnosis artifacts are complete
route to profile/checkpoint audit if L3 zero-success is confirmed
route to task-quality repair if all profile groups remain low support

admission_evidence: M2220 freezes exact metric groups and labels
M2209 episode rows include failure timing and severity metrics
allowed_updates: M2221 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2221 diagnoses outcome metrics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2221.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If L3 zero-success is confirmed, route to profile/checkpoint audit instead of claiming finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns diagnostic matrices into failure-mode metrics
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether recurrent-profile failure is a training/config blocker before any comparison route
must_synthesize_if: M2221 leads to another blind repair

hypothesis: Existing M2209/M2218 metrics can localize L3 recurrent zero-success without rerun or ranking.
success_criteria: no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or ranking is performed
decision_rule: M2221 passes if it writes no-rerun failure-diagnosis artifacts while keeping ranking and winner selection blocked.
